description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open source testing management system. It handles test plan navigation, including initializing the GUI, access control, and rendering the test execution interface.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes the GUI object with configuration, access rights, and interface settings based on user permissions and session state.

methods.name: checkAccessToExec
methods.description: Checks user permissions for executing test plans, retrieving test project ID, and determining access rights.
